credit.credit-words: There Shall Be Showers of Blessing
WORDS: Daniel W. Whittle, 1883. MUSIC: “Showers of Blessing”; James McGranahan, 1883. Public Domain.

I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing. Eze. 34:26 The Lord hath been mindful of us: he will bless us. Psa. 115:12 I will not let thee go, except thou bless me. Gen. 32:26
